title: 3D room view
interaction: Drag: orbit · Shift/right mouse: pan · Wheel: zoom · Arrows: orbit/tilt · 0: reset
levels: Bridge clearance: {{height}} mm · Level spacing: {{spacing}} mm
noRoom: No room assigned yet. Choose one in the room planner to see the track inside it.
note: Orthographic 3D view with smooth ascents and descents. Height settings are saved with the track. Ramps and banked curves are schematic planning aids; supports and structural feasibility are not checked.
slopeNote: Gradients use horizontal track length. Smooth easing has a higher peak than its mean gradient. CU and crossings keep their heights.
railFlat: Keep this rail flat at this height
profileHelp: Click or select a rail. For ramp start, disable flat and set the starting height. Add intermediate/maximum heights and the final flat rail. Point spacing controls custom ramp length; general ramp lengths apply to automatic transitions.
slopeDisconnected: No unambiguous connection to the target rail.
slopeEditHelp: Sets a height point at this rail’s start and a flat target rail. Intermediate height points remain. Negative values produce a descent. Labels show the actual calculated gradient of each rail.
slopeHeightError: Target height would fall outside 0–3000 mm.
slopeUnitError: CU/adapter stays flat. Choose a following rail as ramp start.
slopeError: Choose a valid gradient and a connected target rail.
labelDensity: {{shown}}/{{total}} labels visible. Change zoom/pan for more; edit any value by selecting its rail.
dragLabelHelp: Drag or arrow keys: move · Delete: automatic position
adjustedLabel: Position temporarily adjusted in this view.
snapshotError: The current view could not be captured for export.
snapshotPrintNote: This print view preserves current framing, zoom and visible label positions. PDF exports rails and text as scalable vectors.
suggestHelp: Enter maximum ascent and descent gradients separately. Apply sets the calculated length and updates the 3D view. Smooth ramps have a lower average than maximum gradient. Limited space is indicated. Save the plan afterwards.
customSuggestionHelp: Custom height points define this profile. Adjust these points in the height profile; ramp lengths do not change them.
